name: Vehicle, Snowmobile, and Boat Registrations
description: This dataset contains the file of vehicle, snowmobile and boat registrations in NYS. Registrations expired more than 2 years are excluded. Records that have a scofflaw, revocation and/or suspension are included with indicators specifying those kinds of records.

columns.name: Record Type
VIN
columns.description: The Vehicles Identification Number as assigned by the vehicle manufacturer or by NYS DMV if the original VIN was compromised.

columns.name: Registration Class
columns.description:
An alpha code that is used to classify the registration.
(see complete list of registration classes at the end of the data dictionary)

columns.name: City
columns.description: A city name for mailing purposes; appears in the last line of an address on a mail piece.

columns.name: State
columns.description: The official USPS abbreviation for the name of a mailing state, U.S. territory, Canadian Province, Commonwealth or armed forces ZIP Code designation. If APO/FPO/DPO, then the state abbreviation will be “AA,” “AE,” or “AP.”

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: A code that identifies a specific geographic mail delivery area. ZIP Codes can represent an area within a foreign country, a state, or a single building or company that has a very high mail volume. The zip code appears in the last line of the address on a mail piece. Example: 12345

columns.name: County
columns.description: The New York State county name that is the county of residence or use.

columns.name: Model Year
columns.description: The manufacturer model year of vehicle.

columns.name: Make
columns.description: The DMV code for the make of a vehicle that appears on the registration. The DMV make code is the first 5 letters of the vehicle’s make name. If the vehicle make is more than one word, the make code is the first 2 letters of the first two words with a slash in between. (Examples, CHEVR, HA/DA)

columns.name: Body Type
columns.description:
The body type of a vehicle.
(see the complete list of body types at the end of the data dictionary)

columns.name: Fuel Type
columns.description: The fuel type of a vehicle.

columns.name: Unladen Weight
columns.description: The weight of a passenger vehicle without any load.

columns.name: Maximum Gross Weight
columns.description: The maximum weight that a commercial vehicle is permitted to carry.

columns.name: Passengers
columns.description: The number of passengers that a for-hire vehicle can transport, excluding the driver.

columns.name: Reg Valid Date
columns.description: The date DMV issued the most recent registration document.

columns.name: Reg Expiration Date
columns.description: The date when the registration expires.

columns.name: Color
columns.description: The color of the vehicle. This is the DMV code not the NCIC code. (see the color codes at the end of the data dictionary)

columns.name: Scofflaw Indicator
columns.description: Indicates if a parking or red light scofflaw stop is in effect. (Y/N).

columns.name: Suspension Indicator
columns.description: Indicates if a suspension is in effect. (Y/N).

columns.name: Revocation Indicator
columns.description: Indicates if a revocation is in effect. (Y/N).
